queries: WITH item_town AS (SELECT il.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town, AVG(il.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(il.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(il.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS il JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = il.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY il.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_avg AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - x.cross_town_avg_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM town_avg AS t CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS cross_town_avg_ratio FROM town_avg) AS x WHERE t.avg_ratio > x.cross_town_avg_ratio

WITH item_averages AS (SELECT c.town_city AS town, ili.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price) AS average_price, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.town_city, ili.order_item_id), town_averages AS (SELECT town, AVG(average_price) AS average_price, AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM item_averages GROUP BY town), cross_town AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM town_averages) SELECT t.town, t.average_price, t.average_ratio, t.average_ratio - x.average_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM town_averages AS t CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x WHERE t.average_ratio > x.average_ratio
